examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?
je viens d'arriver = I've just arrived
polite and neutral; salut is more casual

examples.text: Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

meanings.note: before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.
Je suis dévastée par cette nouvelle.
examples.trans: I am devastated by this news.

meanings.en: to almost do, come close to doing

examples.text: Tu as failli dire mon amour!

meanings.note: c'est ma faute = it's my fault

meanings.en: d'habitude / comme d'habitude = usually / as usual

meanings.note: à l'hôpital = in hospital, at the hospital
before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà
object pronoun before the verb: tu me donnes
with reflexive verbs: je me débrouille

examples.text: Je suis là pour voir Mathias.

meanings.note: question word when 'what' is the subject: qu'est-ce qui se passe? = what's happening?
tu viens quand? = when are you coming?

examples.trans: I want to get my bag back.

examples.text: Il récupère les enfants à cinq heures.
examples.trans: He picks up the children at five.

meanings.note: a lost thing, or a lost client

examples.text: Si tu veux le rôle, tu dois changer.
examples.trans: If you want the part, you have to change.

meanings.note: before the verb; t' before a vowel
informal, one owner; ton, ta, tes
takes a singular verb: tout le monde est là
singular and informal: friends, family, children, colleagues of the same age

examples.trans: They're going to kill each other!

meanings.en: se tuer = to kill each other (or oneself)

meanings.note: venir de: je viens de la Côte d'Azur
venir de + infinitive: je viens d'arriver = I've just arrived
place: à Paris, à mon cours

meanings.en: au = à + le, aux = à + les
